ctx.x: Chuck, who were the Dancing Doughboys?
Well, they were the choreographers of "This is the Army." It consisted of Pete Nugent, (unintelligible) Lee, and the now Timmy Rodgers.
That was something that was done during World War II -- the show during World War II?
